title: Martyrologium Romanum Gregorii XIII. Pont. Max. iussu editum, et Urbani VIII. auctoritate recognitum. Accesserunt notationes atque tractatio de Martyrologio Romano, auctore Caesare Baronio Sorano
note: Transcribed from the public-domain scan (Internet Archive bub_gb_2pQUlbrbtAsC) into TEI and proofread against the page images in two passes; long s normalized to s, everything else (u/v, i/j, æ/œ, accents, abbreviation tildes, the printer's misprints) as printed. Baronius's reference letters are removed from the eulogies; his Notationes are included as footnotes, each keyed to its reference letter and to the eulogy and word that letter follows (a note on the day heading, to the day's first eulogy), and the margin notes (mostly references to his Annales) as marginalia, each tied to its footnote or, where it has none, to the eulogy it stands beside. The closing formula is printed once, on 1 January ('Sic semper terminatur lectio Martyrologij'), and is given here for every day.
